rationale: Jarrod 2026-10-26: Grok 4.7 replaces GLM 5.3 Flash in the SDL-2 release lineup, through OpenRouter on the one key like every frontier model. xAI is the model's only provider; pinned to its zero-data-retention endpoint (xai/zdr, same price as xai), no fallbacks, data_collection deny, reasoning effort high. The endpoint accepts temperature and tool_choice, and caches implicitly, so no omit_sampling_controls and no cache_control.
